verdict.rationale: Flagright's Management API documents case status stages, including IN_REVIEW, ESCALATED and custom status IDs, and alert statuses that include ESCALATED. Its marketing claims a Workflow Builder for investigation flows and Case Management. Together these show cases can move through review and escalation stages. No evidence shows case assignment to analysts or how routing between stages is configured. Missing for 10: documented case assignment to analysts or queues, routing rules between review and escalation stages, workflow builder documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can assign cases and route them through analyst review and escalation stages

citations.quote: Workflow Builder - Build investigation flows tailored to compliance logic.
Case Management - Centralize investigations with AI-native workflows.
